name: Somchai Prasert
bio:
Somchai Prasert's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the bustling markets of Bangkok, where he honed his sales skills. After graduating with a marketing degree, he combined his passion for cars and business, landing a role at a local racing team. His knack for understanding consumer behavior and crafting compelling narratives quickly propelled him through the ranks.

At Arrow McLaren, Somchai is known for his meticulous approach to campaign planning. He meticulously analyzes data to identify target audiences and tailors marketing strategies to resonate with each segment. He believes that effective marketing isn't just about promoting a brand; it's about building lasting relationships with fans. Somchai's dedication to understanding the cultural nuances of different markets makes him a valuable asset to the team's global outreach efforts.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a friendly, approachable face and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small Buddha amulet for good luck
Insists on brewing his own strong Thai iced coffee every morning
